hero.title: Turn any product link into a polished review
hero.subtitle: Paste a marketplace link or enter product details manually. We fetch the data, show you what we found, then write your review.

step1.title: Add a product
step1.description: Paste a marketplace URL or fill in title, price, and details yourself.

step2.title: We fetch product details
step2.description: For links, our parser loads title, price, characteristics, and description.

step3.title: AI writes your review
step3.description: Confirm the product data, then get a review in your chosen language and style.
